sessions.summary: The only request was to undo m5, the move that routed aider's LiteLLM traffic for OpenAI models through Router. m5 was the tip of the migration and no approved item builds on it, so a plain git revert was enough: the four files it touched are back to their exact pre-m5 state, aider's OpenAI-model requests go to api.openai.com again as they did before the migration, and m1-m4 still route the app's own clients unchanged. The repo suite passes 10, the same as the baseline.

results.note: Plain revert of e0c0b9a, clean because m5 was the tip and changed no policy; the probe m5's evidence used now sends 0 requests to Router and is blocked as api.openai.com traffic, where m5 had 1 valid /v1/responses request. m1-m4 are untouched and still route the first-party clients (3 valid Router requests with the seed drop, model map and stage labels intact), and the suite passes 10 as before.
